get.summary: Get restatement metric timeline for a statement identity
get.description:
Return the restatement timeline and per-metric deltas for a specific statement identity across version sequences.

A period the filer has reported once has never been restated, and is answered with an empty timeline: `total_hops` is 0, `by_metric` is empty and `timeline_severity` is `NONE`. That is a complete answer rather than missing data, and it is also what a period with two versions that differ in no metric returns.

A statement identity with no versions at all is answered with 404 `EDGAR_STATEMENTS_NOT_FOUND`.

One fiscal identity can hold several period ends, because a quarter is sometimes labelled FY. A timeline covers the revisions of a single period: the one the serving layer returns.

RestatementMetricTimelineHTTP.title: RestatementMetricTimelineHTTP
RestatementMetricTimelineHTTP.description:
HTTP schema for a restatement metric timeline.

This schema represents a hop-aligned, ledger-aware time series of
restatement deltas for a single statement identity. It is the HTTP
projection of :class:`RestatementMetricTimelineDTO`.

Attributes:
    cik:
        Company CIK for the statement identity.
    statement_type:
        Statement type (e.g., INCOME_STATEMENT, BALANCE_SHEET).
    fiscal_year:
        Fiscal year associated with the statement identity.
    fiscal_period:
        Fiscal period (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).
    by_metric:
        Mapping from metric code to a list of [version_order, absolute_delta]
        pairs, both encoded as strings for wire stability. version_order is
        the 1-based hop index within the ledger.
    restatement_frequency:
        Mapping from metric code to the number of hops in which that metric
        exhibited a non-zero absolute delta.
    per_metric_max_delta:
        Mapping from metric code to the largest absolute delta observed
        across all hops, stringified.
    total_hops:
        Total number of hops in the underlying restatement ledger.
    timeline_severity:
        Aggregate severity classification for the timeline, as a string
        (e.g., "NONE", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH").
